# persephone3

[![R-CMD-check](https://github.com/statistikat/persephone3/workflows/R-CMD-check/badge.svg)](https://github.com/statistikat/persephone3/actions)
[![](https://img.shields.io/badge/lifecycle-experimental-orange.svg)](https://www.tidyverse.org/lifecycle/#experimental)
[![](https://img.shields.io/github/languages/code-size/statistikat/persephone3.svg)](https://github.com/statistikat/persephone3)
[![](https://img.shields.io/github/last-commit/statistikat/persephone3.svg)](https://github.com/statistikat/persephone3/commits/master)
[![Codecov test
coverage](https://codecov.io/gh/statistikat/persephone3/branch/master/graph/badge.svg)](https://app.codecov.io/gh/statistikat/persephone3?branch=master)

Object oriented wrapper around the seasonal adjustment packages in the
[rjdverse](https://github.com/rjdverse/). The package performs time
series adjustments with the java library
[JDemetra+](https://jdemetra-new-documentation.netlify.app/) and focuses
on batch processing, hierarchical time series and analytic charts.

## Installation

The following commands install `persephone3` as well as the packages
from the [rjdverse](https://github.com/rjdverse/) that talk with the
java interface.

``` r

# install dependencies
remotes::install_github("rjdverse/rjd3toolkit@*release")
remotes::install_github("rjdverse/rjd3x13@*release")
remotes::install_github("rjdverse/rjd3tramoseats@*release")

# install the package from GitHub
remotes::install_github("statistikat/persephone3")
```

## Usage

Objects can be constructed with
[`perX13()`](https://statistikat.github.io/persephone3/reference/perX13.md)
or
[`perTramo()`](https://statistikat.github.io/persephone3/reference/perTramo.md).
Subsequently, the `run()` method runs the model and `output` gives
access to the output object from
[`rjd3x13::x13_fast()`](https://rjdverse.github.io/rjd3x13/reference/x13.html)
or
[`rjd3tramoseats::tramoseats_fast()`](https://rjdverse.github.io/rjd3tramoseats/reference/tramoseats.html).

``` r

library(persephone3)
```

``` r

# construct a seasonal adjustment object for the AirPassengers dataset
obj <- perX13(AirPassengers)

# run the model
obj$run()

# access the preprocessing slot of the rjd3 output object
obj$output$preprocessing
#> Log-transformation: yes 
#> SARIMA model: (0,1,1) (0,1,1)
#> 
#> SARIMA coefficients:
#>  theta(1) btheta(1) 
#>   -0.4018   -0.5569 
#> 
#> No regression variables
#> 
#> For a more detailed output, use the 'summary()' function.
```

``` r

# visualize the results
obj$plot()
```

## Further reading

This section still needs an update to persephone3.

More information can be found on the [github-pages
site](https://statistikat.github.io/persephone3/) for persephone.

- An overview of the package is available in the \[useR!2019 slides\].
- The [plotting
  vignette](https://statistikat.github.io/persephone3/articles/persephone-plotting.html)
  contains examples of interactive plots htat can be created with
  `persephone`.
- More information about hierarchical time series can be found in the
  [hierarchical timeseries
  vignette](https://statistikat.github.io/persephone3/articles/persephone-hierarchical.html).

# Package index

## Classes

- [`hierarchicalTimeSeries`](https://statistikat.github.io/persephone3/reference/hierarchicalTimeSeries.md)
  : R6 Class for hierarchical time series
- [`multipleTimeSeries`](https://statistikat.github.io/persephone3/reference/multipleTimeSeries.md)
  : R6 Class for a batch of time series
- [`tramoseatsSingle`](https://statistikat.github.io/persephone3/reference/tramoseatsSingle.md)
  : tramoseats class
- [`x13Single`](https://statistikat.github.io/persephone3/reference/x13Single.md)
  : x13 class
- [`persephone`](https://statistikat.github.io/persephone3/reference/persephone.md)
  : persephone class
- [`persephoneSingle`](https://statistikat.github.io/persephone3/reference/persephoneSingle.md)
  : Class for single time series

## Main Functions

- [`perBatch()`](https://statistikat.github.io/persephone3/reference/perBatch.md)
  : Define a multiple time series
- [`perHts()`](https://statistikat.github.io/persephone3/reference/perHts.md)
  : Define a hierarchical time series
- [`perTramo()`](https://statistikat.github.io/persephone3/reference/perTramo.md)
  : tramoseats class
- [`perX13()`](https://statistikat.github.io/persephone3/reference/perX13.md)
  : x13 class
- [`persephone`](https://statistikat.github.io/persephone3/reference/persephone.md)
  : persephone class
- [`persephoneSingle`](https://statistikat.github.io/persephone3/reference/persephoneSingle.md)
  : Class for single time series

## Dashboard

- [`dashboard_compare()`](https://statistikat.github.io/persephone3/reference/dashboard_compare.md)
  : Compare two single series dashboards
- [`dashboard_single()`](https://statistikat.github.io/persephone3/reference/dashboard_single.md)
  : Generate diagnostic dashboard for single time series
- [`createDashboard()`](https://statistikat.github.io/persephone3/reference/createDashboard.md)
  [`createDashboard_single()`](https://statistikat.github.io/persephone3/reference/createDashboard.md)
  [`createDashboard_hts()`](https://statistikat.github.io/persephone3/reference/createDashboard.md)
  [`createDashboard_compare()`](https://statistikat.github.io/persephone3/reference/createDashboard.md)
  : Create diagnostic dashboard for time series objects

## Diagnostic & Utilities

- [`diagnosticsTable()`](https://statistikat.github.io/persephone3/reference/diagnosticsTable.md)
  : Diagnostics table for persephone objects
- [`eaDist_approx`](https://statistikat.github.io/persephone3/reference/eaDist_approx.md)
  : Distribution of the dates for Easter (Approximation)
- [`eaDist_exact`](https://statistikat.github.io/persephone3/reference/eaDist_exact.md)
  : Distribution of the dates for Easter (Exact)
- [`fixModel()`](https://statistikat.github.io/persephone3/reference/fixModel.md)
  : Fix ARIMA model parameters
- [`fixOutlier()`](https://statistikat.github.io/persephone3/reference/fixOutlier.md)
  : Fix outliers in the model
- [`genTd()`](https://statistikat.github.io/persephone3/reference/genTd.md)
  : Generation of trading day regressors
- [`generateQrTable()`](https://statistikat.github.io/persephone3/reference/generateQrTable.md)
  : Generate figures from the EUROSTAT quality report
- [`is.persephone()`](https://statistikat.github.io/persephone3/reference/is.persephone.md)
  [`as.persephone()`](https://statistikat.github.io/persephone3/reference/is.persephone.md)
  : is.persephone
- [`iterate()`](https://statistikat.github.io/persephone3/reference/iterate.md)
  : Iterate over a hierarchical persephone object

## Example Data

- [`pi_caladj`](https://statistikat.github.io/persephone3/reference/pi_caladj.md)
  : Production in industry - Calendar adjusted, not seasonally adjusted
- [`pi_sa`](https://statistikat.github.io/persephone3/reference/pi_sa.md)
  : Production in industry - Seasonally and calendar adjusted
- [`pi_unadj`](https://statistikat.github.io/persephone3/reference/pi_unadj.md)
  : Production in industry - Unadjusted data (i.e. neither seasonally
  adjusted nor calendar adjusted data)
- [`weights_pi_eu28`](https://statistikat.github.io/persephone3/reference/weights_pi_eu28.md)
  : Production Weightings: Countries' share as a \\ (except
  construction)
- [`weights_pi_ea19`](https://statistikat.github.io/persephone3/reference/weights_pi_ea19.md)
  : Production Weightings: Countries' share as a \\ (except
  construction)

## Plotting

- [`hchart(`*`<persephoneSingle>`*`)`](https://statistikat.github.io/persephone3/reference/hchart.persephoneSingle.md)
  : Interactive Highcharts plot for single persephone objects
- [`plot(`*`<hierarchicalTimeSeries>`*`)`](https://statistikat.github.io/persephone3/reference/plot.md)
  [`plot(`*`<persephoneSingle>`*`)`](https://statistikat.github.io/persephone3/reference/plot.md)
  : Interactive time series plot for a persephone object
- [`plotResiduals()`](https://statistikat.github.io/persephone3/reference/plotResiduals.md)
  : Several interactive plots in connection with residuals for a
  persephone object
- [`plotSeasIrrCal()`](https://statistikat.github.io/persephone3/reference/plotSeasIrrCal.md)
  : Interactive Seasonal, Irregular, and Calendar Effects Plot
- [`plotSeasIrrCalDygraph()`](https://statistikat.github.io/persephone3/reference/plotSeasIrrCalDygraph.md)
  : Interactive Seasonal, Irregular, and Calendar Effects Plot
- [`plotSeasIrrCalHc()`](https://statistikat.github.io/persephone3/reference/plotSeasIrrCalHc.md)
  : Interactive Seasonal, Irregular, and Calendar Effects Plot
- [`plotSpectrum()`](https://statistikat.github.io/persephone3/reference/plotSpectrum.md)
  : Spectral Plots
- [`plotSpectrumGgplot()`](https://statistikat.github.io/persephone3/reference/plotSpectrumGgplot.md)
  : Spectral Plots (ggplot2 version)
- [`plotSpectrumHc()`](https://statistikat.github.io/persephone3/reference/plotSpectrumHc.md)
  : Spectral Plots (Interactive)
- [`plotSiRatios()`](https://statistikat.github.io/persephone3/reference/plotSiRatios.md)
  : SI-Ratio Plot
- [`plotSiRatiosGgplot()`](https://statistikat.github.io/persephone3/reference/plotSiRatiosGgplot.md)
  : SI-Ratio Plot (ggplot2 version)
- [`plotSiRatiosHc()`](https://statistikat.github.io/persephone3/reference/plotSiRatiosHc.md)
  : SI-Ratio Plot (Interactive)

## Internal Functions

- [`generate_diagnostics_table()`](https://statistikat.github.io/persephone3/reference/generate_diagnostics_table.md)
  : Generate diagnostics table for persephone objects (internal)
- [`generate_Qr_List()`](https://statistikat.github.io/persephone3/reference/generate_Qr_List.md)
  : Generates a list containing the figures for a EUROSTAT quality
  report
- [`hc_add_forecast()`](https://statistikat.github.io/persephone3/reference/hc_add_forecast.md)
  : Add forecast to highchart (internal helper)

# Articles

### User Guides

- [Get started with
  persephone3](https://statistikat.github.io/persephone3/articles/persephone3.md):

  A comprehensive introduction to seasonal adjustment with persephone3,
  covering installation, basic usage, and parameter customization.

- [Plotting with
  persephone3](https://statistikat.github.io/persephone3/articles/persephone-plotting.md):

  Interactive visualizations for seasonal adjustment results using
  dygraphs, plotly, and highcharter.

- [Hierarchical time series with
  persephone3](https://statistikat.github.io/persephone3/articles/persephone-hierarchical.md):

  Working with hierarchical time series: creating, adjusting, and
  iterating over multiple levels of aggregation.

- [Hierarchical time series - construction and
  weights](https://statistikat.github.io/persephone3/articles/persephone-hierarchicalEU.md):
